import Mathlib
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators InnerProductSpace
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Rudin_exercise_1_18a
  (n : ℕ)
  (h : n > 1)
  (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) -- R^n
  : ∃ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), y ≠ 0 ∧ ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
  classical
  have hpos : 0 < n := lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one h
  let i0 : Fin n := ⟨0, hpos⟩
  let i1 : Fin n := ⟨1, h⟩
  have hi0i1 : i0 ≠ i1 := by
    intro hij
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val hij
    simp [i0, i1] at hv
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · refine ⟨EuclideanSpace.single i0 (1 : ℝ), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hzero
      have hv := congrArg (fun z => z i0) hzero
      simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, i0] at hv
    · simp [hx]
  · have hxcoord : ∃ i, x i ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h'
      push_neg at h'
      apply hx
      ext i
      simpa [Pi.zero_apply] using h' i
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxcoord
    let j : Fin n := if hi : i = i0 then i1 else i0
    have hij : i ≠ j := by
      by_cases hi : i = i0
      · have hj : j = i1 := by simp [j, hi]
        simpa [hi, hj] using hi0i1
      · have hj : j = i0 := by simp [j, hi]
        simpa [hj] using hi
    let y := EuclideanSpace.single i (x j) -
      EuclideanSpace.single j (x i)
    have hji : j ≠ i := Ne.symm hij
    have hyj : y j = -x i := by
      simp [y, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hji]
    have hy : y ≠ 0 := by
      intro hyzero
      have hv := congrArg (fun z => z j) hyzero
      have : x i = 0 := by simpa [hyj] using hv
      exact hxi this
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
    simp [y, inner_sub_right, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, mul_comm]

theorem Rudin_exercise_1_18a

  (h : n > 1)
  (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) -- R^n
  : ∃ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), y ≠ 0 ∧ ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
  let i0 : Fin n := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let i1 : Fin n := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  let e0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ i0
  let e1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ i1
  by_cases hz : x i0 = 0 ∧ x i1 = 0
  · refine ⟨e0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ).orthonormal.ne_zero i0
    · rw [show e0 = (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) i0 by rfl]
      rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_basisFun_real]
      exact hz.1
  · let y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := x i1 • e0 - x i0 • e1
    refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hy
      have hy0 : y i0 = x i1 := by
        simp [y, e0, e1, i0, i1]
      have hy1 : y i1 = -x i0 := by
        simp [y, e0, e1, i0, i1]
      have hx1 : x i1 = 0 := by

          _ = 0 := by simp [hy]
      have hx0 : x i0 = 0 := by

      exact hz ⟨hx0, hx1⟩
    · dsimp [y]
      rw [inner_sub_right, inner_smul_right, inner_smul_right,
        EuclideanSpace.inner_basisFun_real,
        EuclideanSpace.inner_basisFun_real]
      simp
